panels.description: Apollo restore reports on both paths with an `outcome` label (restored|empty). A rising `empty` rate means cold starts run on an empty cache.
panels.title: Cache & Store Restore (P95)

panels.description: Writes waiting to replay. A depth that never returns to zero means the queue is not draining - see docs/local-first-architecture.md.
panels.title: Offline Queue Depth

panels.description: Writes the queue gave up on. Each one is user work accepted locally that never reached the server.
panels.title: Offline Queue Permanent Failures (1h)

panels.description: Cold starts that restored a persisted cache vs found none. A rising 'empty' share means every launch refetches everything.
panels.title: Apollo Cache Restore Outcome

panels.description: Size of the serialized Apollo cache written to MMKV. Drives restore cost at cold start and the idle-time serialize cost.
panels.title: Persisted Cache Size

panels.description: TTID: React Native's root view is mounted. Says nothing about whether the screen's data arrived — compare against app_fully_drawn_ms. Origin caveat: nativeLaunchStart is derived from elapsed CPU time on both platforms, so this understates real time-to-first-frame. Compare each platform against itself, across builds, and nothing else.
panels.title: First Frame — app_content_appeared_ms (P50/P95)

panels.description: JS-bundle entry to the first instrumented list finishing layout WITH real content. Does not emit when the launch stopped for user input (sign-in, verification, onboarding), when no instrumented list rendered, or when the Hermes startup profiler armed — so gaps are expected and are not the same as a regression.
panels.title: First Meaningful Paint — app_fully_drawn_ms (P50/P95)

list.description: App version, labelled on every metric. Select two to compare a release against its predecessor - the startup panels split by it. The commit SHA is deliberately NOT a metric label (unbounded cardinality); it travels on logs as the git_sha field.
list.label: App version
list.name: version

list.description: Emulator vs physical hardware. Measured 2026-08-25 the two disagree by 1.4-2x on startup marks and by 10-20x on flashlist_initial_load_ms, so a panel that blends them is not comparable against anything - the startup panels split by it. Bounded to two values on purpose: device_model would be the same cardinality bomb as a commit SHA.
list.label: Device type
list.name: device_type
